samples.question: This image has two framed panels, one above the other. In each panel the short black bar at the bottom left is that panel's unit ruler, and the two panels use different unit-ruler lengths. The upper panel contains four horizontal colored bars (red, blue, green, orange). The lower panel contains four horizontal gray bars. Every bar and every unit ruler starts at the same left edge inside its own panel. A bar's value is its length divided by the length of the unit ruler in its own panel. The four values in the lower panel are exactly the four values in the upper panel, so each gray bar has one matching colored bar. The small black square in the left margin of the lower panel marks one gray bar. Which colored bar has the same value as the marked gray bar? Answer with one word: red, blue, green, or orange.
